entities.name: fQRS and PVC frequency
observations: In a retrospective 282-patient cohort described as having no overt structural heart disease, fQRS prevalence increased across <120, 120–720, and >720 PVCs/24 h groups: 26.2%, 46.2%, and 65.9%.
Multinomial regression associated fQRS with frequent PVCs (OR 2.11, 95% CI 1.00–4.45, p=0.05); observational evidence does not establish causation. PMID:25430411.

entities.name: PVC burden and fQRS
observations: In a retrospective 199-patient palpitation cohort, fQRS was more prevalent with PVC burden >10% than <10% (47.5% vs 30.6%, p=0.015); no adjusted estimate was reported, and an idiopathic-only population was not established. PMID:34493030.
